content:
Morgan: Quick sync — can we get a short status on Console observability milestones? need owners for tracing hook rollout, dashboard panels, error-analysis views, and retention cutover.
Devon: I can own tracing hook rollout, but I need a blocker list first. what's the runtime dependency?
Anna: Runtime needs the new trace tag schema (trace.source + trace.env) shipped. eng-runtime said they can land it by Tue if we drop the final schema PR today.
Sam: tagging @Devon fyi — runtime PR is https://git.internal/redwood/eng-runtime/pull/432 (CI flaked yesterday).
Devon: got it. I'll queue review today. can someone confirm the set of services that need hook instrumentation?
Lee: Service list: api-gateway, inference-router, cache-proxy, console-backend. I'll paste the short checklist: 
```
- api-gateway: header passthrough + prefix tagging
- inference-router: kv-cache span around request processing
- cache-proxy: latency spans + hit/miss tag
- console-backend: trace enrichment + sample decision
```
Tia: For dashboards, product wants two new panels: 1) trace volume by model/version, 2) error rate per route with sampled traces link. I can prototype panel configs and share json for import.
Morgan: timeline ask — can we have tracing hooks deployed to staging by end of week and dashboards ready for review early next week? retention cutover (reduce 365->90 days) is targeted for 2026-05-10.
Anna: retention cutover depends on approvals from compliance + finance. I'm waiting on finance to OK cost model. cc @Sam for cost numbers.
Sam: Finance gave provisional OK if 90-day retention reduces storage spend by ~48%. I'll attach the short calc in this thread.
Sam: calc snippet: 
```
- current: 365d -> 2.1TB/day * 365 = 766.5 TB/year
- target: 90d -> 2.1TB/day * 90 = 189 TB/year
- est savings ~ 577 TB/year (~48% after compression/retention anomalies)
```
Devon: runtime note — switching trace sampling policy affects QPS on the trace-collector. we should coordinate a canary for sampling change (30% -> 10%) when retention cutover happens.
Lee: I'll add a canary runbook. quick question: do we have a fallback if the trace-collector spikes? obs-bot can page if ingestion > 75% of capacity?
obs-bot: deploy-check: trace-collector ingestion alert is configured: pager at 75% capacity, auto-throttle will drop sampling if >85%.
Tia: For dashboards, I'll push a draft JSON to the dashboards repo today: dashboards/console/trace_panels/190512. Would be great if reviewers can do pass by EOD.
Morgan: ownership summary please — Devon = tracing hooks rollout; Tia = dashboard panels; Lee = canary + runbook; Anna = retention approvals coord; Sam = cost/finance liaison. If anyone wants to swap, say now.
Anna: confirmed for retention approvals. I'll ping compliance tomorrow.
Devon: confirmed for hooks. planning a single PR with incremental feature flags per service.
Sam: I'll post the finance breakdown and add SKU-level cost notes.
Lee: working on the runbook, adding rollback steps and throttling tests. ETA Thu morning.
Tia: dashboards PR link when ready — will add sample trace links and panel IDs.
Morgan: blockers: runtime PR review (Anna/Sam help), instrumenting api-gateway (needs one lib change), compliance signoff. anything else?
Anna: one more: we need to update docs for new trace tags in the SDKs, I'll create a small docs PR once schema is final.
Devon: quick dev question — for console-backend enrichment, do we prefer adding tags at ingress or in the handler? I vote ingress (single place).
Lee: ingress is nicer for consistency. but ensure we don't duplicate spans. add an idempotency check (trace.enriched=true).
Morgan: ok, next steps: 1) Devon to land PRs + feature flags; 2) Anna to coordinate retention approvals; 3) Tia to draft dashboards and request review; 4) Lee to finalize runbook + canary; 5) Sam to post cost calc. We'll reconvene async here. if anyone hits a blocker, ping @Morgan or reply here. :thumbsup:
Devon: will update thread with PR links as they land.
obs-bot: ci: eng-runtime/pr-432 passed tests at 1905126700 (flaky tests retried).
Sam: finance note posted: https://docs.internal/fin/trace-retention-90d.md
Tia: dashboards PR opened: https://git.internal/redwood/dashboards/pull/128 — comments welcome.
Morgan: thanks all — logging this as a short milestone: staging tracing hooks by Fri, dashboards review Mon, retention cutover 2026-05-10 (pending approvals). I'll set a calendar reminder.
Devon: :rocket: 
Anna: :+1: 
Lee: adding runbook link to the runbooks repo after tests.
obs-bot: reminder scheduled: retention-cutover-review in 7d (1905134056).
